Adding technical context: the v2 quantization path has a known perf regression for sequences >1k tokens under current kernel selection. Canary plan looks good but we need to limit traffic to a small cohort and enable KV-cache bypass for early rollback. Proposed changes:
- Canary cohort = 2% of production, no heavy prompt customers
- Metrics: token throughput, P95 latency, failed completions >1%
- Rollback: automatic fallback to v1 when P95 > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive mins

Forwarding a note from the Greenfield procurement contact I just received — procurement timeline looks tight and could push us to prioritize packaging for their security review.
